description: End-to-end data governance workflow for CPaaS/TaaS conversations, covering classification, policy evaluation, redaction, consent management, retention, export, and rollback.

conversation_id.description: Unique identifier of a conversation within the CPaaS platform

message_id.description: Unique identifier of a single message within a conversation

policy_id.description: Unique identifier of a data governance policy

governance_job_id.description: Identifier of an asynchronous governance job (e.g., classification, redaction, export)

actor.description: Entity performing an action for audit purposes

actor_type.description: Type of actor initiating the action

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor (e.g., user ID, service ID)

ip_address.description: Optional IP address of the actor

user_agent.description: Optional user agent string for the actor's client

consent_record.description: Represents a consent event related to a conversation or participant

subject_id.description: ID of the subject the consent applies to (conversation_id, participant_id, etc.)

purpose.description: Purpose for which consent is granted or revoked

metadata.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with the consent record

functions.name: classify_conversation_data
functions.description: Analyze and classify a conversation for sensitivity, PII presence, and data domains to determine applicable governance controls.

message_ids.description: If provided, restrict analysis to specific messages

time_range.description: Restrict analysis to messages within the specified time range

include_attachments.description: Whether to include attachments in classification

classification_profile.description: Configuration for how classification should be performed

custom_detectors.description: Custom detector configurations by ID or name

max_tokens.description: Max number of tokens to inspect to limit resource usage

async.description: If true, run classification asynchronously and return a governance_job_id

functions.returns: If async=true: governance_job_id and queued status; if async=false: classification summary with detected PII types, sensitivity level, and suggested policies.

functions.name: evaluate_conversation_policies
functions.description: Evaluate data governance policies for a conversation based on its metadata, classification results, and jurisdiction.

policy_ids.description: Specific policy IDs to evaluate; if omitted, all applicable policies are evaluated

jurisdictions.description: List of jurisdictions (e.g., regions, countries) that may apply

data_subject_regions.description: Regions of data subjects involved in the conversation

inputs.description: Optional pre-computed inputs that can be used during policy evaluation

classification_job_id.description: Job ID from classify_conversation_data if classification was asynchronous

classification_snapshot.description: Inline classification result if already available

consent_state.description: Existing consent records relevant to this conversation

evaluation_mode.description: Full evaluation considers all policies; incremental only evaluates potential changes from new inputs

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report containing matched policies, required actions (e.g., redact, restrict_export), and justification for each decision.

functions.name: enforce_redaction_on_conversation
functions.description: Apply redaction rules to messages and attachments in a conversation according to evaluated policies.

redaction_plan.description: Explicit redaction instructions or rules to apply

mode.description: Auto uses policy engine decisions; manual uses provided rules only

rules.description: List of redaction rules to apply

pattern_value.description: PII type, regex, or field name depending on pattern_type

message_filter.description: Filter specifying which messages the rule applies to

roles.description: Only apply to messages from certain roles

dry_run.description: If true, generate a redaction preview without modifying stored data

policy_reference.description: Reference to policies or evaluations that triggered this enforcement

evaluation_id.description: Identifier for a prior policy evaluation run

async.description: Run redaction as an asynchronous job if true

functions.returns: If async=true: governance_job_id and queued status; if async=false: summary of redactions applied or preview details including counts and affected messages.

functions.name: manage_consent_for_conversation
functions.description: Create or update consent records associated with a conversation or its participants for specific processing purposes.

operation.description: Type of consent operation to perform

conversation_id.description: Conversation related to the consent event (optional for some subject types)

subject_id.description: ID of the subject (e.g., participant_id, external user identifier)

purpose.description: Purpose of processing (e.g., analytics, training, support_history)

evidence.description: Evidence of consent such as captured text or audio reference

reference.description: Reference to the stored evidence (e.g., URL, document_id)

existing_consent_id.description: Existing consent_id to update or revoke, required for update/revoke operations

functions.returns: Updated consent_record including consent_id, status, timestamps, and any prior record state if modified.

functions.name: configure_conversation_retention
functions.description: Configure retention and deletion rules for a conversation, including overrides of global or policy-based defaults.

retention_policy.description: Retention policy configuration for this conversation

mode.description: inherit uses default policies, override sets custom rules, suspend_deletion pauses deletions

ttl_days.description: Time-to-live in days after conversation closure before deletion

hard_delete.description: If true, data is irreversibly deleted at end of retention

soft_delete_grace_period_days.description: If hard_delete=false, number of days conversation remains recoverable after deletion

reason.description: Reason for changing the retention settings

functions.returns: Updated retention configuration including effective TTL, legal hold status, and information about inherited vs overridden settings.

functions.name: export_conversation_data
functions.description: Export conversation data in a governance-compliant format for data subject access requests or audit purposes.

redaction_level.description: Level of redaction to apply to exported data

delivery.description: How exported data should be delivered or stored

bucket.description: Object store bucket or container name

path.description: Object path or key within the bucket

custom_redaction_rules.description: Optional additional redaction rules only for this export

request_context.description: Context about the export request (e.g., DSAR identifier)

data_subject_identifier.description: Identifier of the data subject, if applicable

functions.returns: If async=true: governance_job_id and queued status; if async=false: export artifact metadata, including URLs or storage references and applied redaction summary.

functions.name: get_governance_job_status
functions.description: Retrieve status and results for a governance-related asynchronous job such as classification, redaction, or export.
functions.returns: Governance job status including state (queued, running, completed, failed), progress, error details if any, and references to result artifacts (e.g., export URL, classification snapshot).

functions.name: retry_governance_job
functions.description: Retry a failed or expired governance job such as redaction or export, optionally adjusting parameters.

retry_strategy.description: Controls how the retry is performed

mode.description: Resume continues from last checkpoint; restart begins from scratch

override_parameters.description: Optional subset of parameters to override for the new attempt; structure depends on original job type

functions.returns: New governance_job_id for the retried job, along with linkage to the original job and initial status.

functions.name: rollback_conversation_changes
functions.description: Rollback previously applied governance changes such as redactions or deletions when soft-recovery is available.

governance_job_id.description: If source=governance_job, specify the job whose changes should be rolled back

audit_version_id.description: If source=audit_version, use this audit snapshot as rollback base

rollback_to_time.description: If source=timestamp, rollback state to this approximate time

scope.description: Limit rollback to specific parts of the conversation

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate rollback and return a diff

reason.description: Reason explaining why rollback is required

functions.returns: If async=true: governance_job_id and status; if async=false: rollback summary including changes reverted, conflicts, and items that could not be restored.

functions.name: get_conversation_governance_state
functions.description: Retrieve the current governance-related state for a conversation, including classification, policy decisions, and active holds.
functions.returns: Snapshot of governance state for the conversation, including classification labels, applied policies, retention config, consent records, and recent enforcement actions.

functions.name: list_conversations_for_governance
functions.description: Search and list conversations that match specified governance-related filters for bulk operations or reporting.

has_pii.description: Whether conversation is classified as containing PII

policy_ids.description: Conversations where these policies apply or have been evaluated

org_unit_ids.description: Organizational units or tenants these conversations belong to

consent_required_but_missing.description: Filter conversations where consent is required by policy but not present

functions.returns: Paginated list of conversations with summary governance metadata (sensitivity, retention, policy flags) and cursors for further navigation.

functions.name: apply_bulk_governance_action
functions.description: Apply a bulk governance action such as mass redaction, retention changes, or export across multiple conversations.

target.description: Defines which conversations are targeted by this bulk action

conversation_ids.description: Explicit list of conversation IDs if selection_mode=explicit_ids

search_filters.description: Filters compatible with list_conversations_for_governance if selection_mode=search_query

safety_limits.description: Limits to avoid accidentally impacting too many conversations

max_conversations.description: Upper bound on number of conversations to affect

sample_first.description: If true, only act on a small sample and return preview

functions.returns: Bulk governance job metadata including governance_job_id, estimated number of affected conversations, and whether operation is in sample mode or full execution.

functions.name: audit_governance_activity
functions.description: Query the audit trail of governance-related actions taken on conversations for compliance and oversight.

event_types.description: Types of governance events to retrieve

include_details.description: If true, include detailed payload snapshots when available

functions.returns: Paginated list of audit events including timestamps, actor details, event type, target conversation, governance_job_id (if applicable), and summary of the change.

functions.name: bulk_import_conversations
functions.description: Bulk-import multiple conversations from an upstream source with validation and idempotency keys.

mapping.description: Field mapping from source to canonical schema

functions.returns: A bulk-import job descriptor with counts of accepted, rejected, and quarantined conversations, plus a job_id for follow-up.

functions.name: bulk_update_conversations
functions.description: Apply a partial update to a batch of conversations matched by filter or id list.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

patch.description: Fields to patch on each matched item

functions.returns: Summary of matched, updated, and skipped conversations with per-item error details.

functions.name: bulk_archive_conversations
functions.description: Archive (soft-delete) a batch of conversations with retention metadata and audit reasons.
functions.returns: Per-id archive results with new lifecycle state.

functions.name: bulk_export_conversations
functions.description: Export a filtered set of conversations to a downstream destination (S3, GCS, blob, SFTP).

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Export job handle including job_id, expected object URIs, row count, and signed download URLs when applicable.

functions.name: search_conversations_advanced
functions.description: Advanced faceted search across conversations with full-text, structured filters, aggregations, and sort.

query.description: Full-text query string with Lucene-like syntax

functions.returns: Search response with conversations hits, total count, aggregation buckets, and a next-cursor.

functions.name: create_conversation_subscription
functions.description: Create a subscription that fires webhooks or notifications on conversation lifecycle events.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created subscription including subscription_id, active state, and last_delivery info (initially null).

functions.name: list_conversation_subscriptions
functions.description: List existing conversation subscriptions with optional filters and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of subscription objects including delivery health stats.

functions.name: deactivate_conversation_subscription
functions.description: Deactivate or delete a conversation subscription and optionally flush pending deliveries.
functions.returns: Updated subscription state and the number of pending deliveries flushed or kept.

functions.name: get_conversation_audit_log
functions.description: Return the audit/change log for a single conversation with field-level diffs and actor info.

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Chronological list of audit events with before/after diffs, actor, and source IP/system.

functions.name: search_audit_events
functions.description: Search audit events across conversations for compliance and forensic review.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated audit-event hits with cross-entity references.

functions.name: schedule_conversation_job
functions.description: Create a recurring schedule that triggers a named operation on a target set of conversations.

operation.description: Named operation to invoke (e.g., refresh, recompute, export, reconcile)

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: The created scheduled-job descriptor with job_id, next_run_at, and current status.

functions.name: list_conversation_jobs
functions.description: List scheduled or in-flight jobs related to conversations with status filtering and pagination.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated list of conversation jobs and their last run summaries.

functions.name: cancel_conversation_job
functions.description: Cancel a scheduled or in-flight conversation job, optionally interrupting running steps.
functions.returns: Updated job status with cancellation timestamp and any side effects.

functions.name: simulate_conversation_change
functions.description: Simulate a proposed change against a conversation (or batch) without committing; returns expected diffs and warnings.
functions.returns: Simulation result with predicted diffs, rule violations, cost/SLA impact, and a confidence score.

functions.name: request_conversation_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a sensitive conversation change requiring reviewer sign-off.
functions.returns: Created approval request with approval_request_id, current state, and notification targets.

functions.name: submit_conversation_approval_decision
functions.description: Submit an approve, reject, or request-changes decision against a conversation approval request.
functions.returns: Updated approval request state including quorum progress and final decision (if reached).

functions.name: add_conversation_comment
functions.description: Append a comment or annotation to a conversation, optionally attaching files or mentioning users.
functions.returns: The created comment object with comment_id, timestamps, and visibility-resolved permissions.

functions.name: list_conversation_comments
functions.description: List comments and annotations attached to a conversation, with optional thread expansion.
functions.returns: Paginated comment list with thread tree and attachment metadata.

functions.name: snapshot_conversation
functions.description: Create a point-in-time immutable snapshot of a conversation for forensic, rollback, or compliance use.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, checksum, byte size, and retention expiry.

functions.name: restore_conversation_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a conversation from a previously created snapshot, optionally as a new copy.
functions.returns: Restore job descriptor including resulting id and any per-field conflicts that were resolved.

functions.name: get_conversation_metrics
functions.description: Compute KPI metrics over conversations (counts, MTTR, SLA compliance, error rates) for a time window.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Time-bucketed metric series and aggregate KPIs for the matched conversations.

functions.name: build_conversation_dashboard
functions.description: Persist a named dashboard composed of widgets (charts, tables, single-stat) over conversations data.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

time_range.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Created dashboard descriptor with dashboard_id, shareable URL, and computed first-render preview.

functions.name: upsert_conversation_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule used to govern conversation behavior, validation, or routing.
functions.returns: Persisted policy with policy_id, version, rule count, and validation warnings (if any).

functions.name: list_conversation_policies
functions.description: List policies governing conversations with version, scope, and lifecycle filters.

created_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

updated_between.description: Time window for filtering or scoping the operation

functions.returns: Paginated policy entries with rule counts and last evaluation metrics.

functions.name: link_conversation_dependencies
functions.description: Establish or update dependency links between a conversation and related artefacts.
functions.returns: Updated dependency graph summary with added/removed/updated edges.
